title: Uniform string tester
statement: Let $D$ be a domain, let a finite family of predicates on $D$ be specified with an arity for each predicate, and let $V$ be a set of coordinates. A uniform string tester consists of a finite, nonempty seed space, a choice of predicate for each seed, and an ordered tuple of distinct queried coordinates of the required arity for each seed, with every coordinate in $V$ queried for at least one seed.
hypotheses_covered: A specified finite family of predicates on the domain, each with an arity
The seed space is finite and nonempty
Each seed selects an ordered tuple of distinct coordinates of the selected predicate's arity
Every coordinate in the variable set is queried for at least one seed
